fees.label: Commercial plan review and permit — valuation tables
fees.citation_note: FY 2027 Development Fee Schedule, revised October 2026. Commercial plan review and commercial permit fees follow valuation tables. Unless a line says otherwise, fees are subject to a 4% technological improvement surcharge and a 4% Development Services surcharge. This page does not state a permit total. Do not use the residential square-foot table on a commercial bid.

gotchas.title: Do not use the residential square-foot table on a commercial bid
checklist: Commercial fees follow the valuation tables
SAWS fees are a separate section
anti_patterns: Using a new-home square-foot total as the commercial permit
